component.name: Reolink Linux Client
component.summary: Native Linux client for Reolink cameras and NVRs

description.p: A fully native Linux desktop client for Reolink cameras and NVRs — a 1:1 replica of the official Reolink Client. Live grid (1/4/9/16) with hardware-accelerated H.264/H.265 decode, double-click maximize and fullscreen, PTZ, snapshots, manual recording, a color-coded playback timeline, an events inbox, and the full device-settings surface.
Not affiliated with or endorsed by Reolink.
Initial development release: live view, playback, events, and settings.
